Wood and stone have no requirement. Axes, pickaxes, shovels, and hoes also always have no requirement.
Leather: scale 15, applied to Dexterity.
Copper armour: scale 15 split between Strength and Intelligence.
Chainmail and gold: scale 22; chainmail splits Strength/Dexterity and gold armour splits Strength/Intelligence.
Iron: scale 20. Diamond: 45. Netherite: 65.
Mace and trident bases use scale 65; elytra uses 90.
Unknown supported materials use scale 10.

Armour, weapon type, and material decide which attributes receive that scale. Maces and shields use Strength; swords and spears split Strength/Dexterity; bows and crossbows use Dexterity. A trident requires 20 Strength and 32 Dexterity, while an Elytra requires 45 Dexterity and 45 Intelligence. Armour follows its base affinity. Reduced Requirements scales each nonzero requirement and rounds the result to the nearest whole point.
When one or more requirements are not met, item-derived modifiers are halved, including final attack/reload speed handling. The tooltip marks unmet requirements in red.
Equipping an item without meeting every listed requirement does not disable it, but all item-derived modifiers are reduced by half until the requirements are met.
